thread:
Priya (support): Heads up — customer X filed a ticket: per-model throughput graphs in Console show flat 0 QPS starting ~2026-03-16 14:00 UTC. Customers seeing API success & real traffic, just graphs are dead. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/links/abc123 :frowning:
Sam (eng-oncall): on it. which dashboard/panel? panel id?
Priya (support): dash: /dashboards/model-throughput, panel "Per-model QPS (by model)". Affects all customers in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Ticket id 2324.
Maya (observability): I can see a gap in Prometheus scrape logs around 14:00 for the exporter that labels model_id. prometheus scrape jobs still up. looks like label keys changed on the exporter side.
observability-bot: alert: missing_series:model_qps_total{model_id!=""} firing on grafana-alerts for 18m
Alix (eng-runtime): Any recent deploys to the metrics-exporter? we pushed a refactor yesterday that changed label names from "model" -> "model_id" and "env" -> "deployment" but should be backwards compatible.
Sam (eng-oncall): deployment history: metrics-exporter v2.4.1 rolled out eu-west-1 @ 2026-03-16T13:55:12Z, us-west-2 @ 13:58:30Z. that matches onset.
Jonathan (platform): Our dashboards query metric model_qps_total with label model="<id>". If exporter changed to model_id label name, queries will return zero. quick fix: either update Prometheus relabeling to populate model label, or change Grafana queries to use model_id.
Priya (support): Customer needs graphs back ASAP. Which is lower-risk?
Maya (observability): Low-risk: add a prometheus relabel_config to copy model_id -> model at scrape time (native relabel). Example:

  - source_labels: ["__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_model_id"]
    target_label: "model"

This will restore previous label shape without touching dashboards.

Alternatively update all dashboard panels — more invasive and error-prone for this incident.
Sam (eng-oncall): I'll open a rollout for relabel patch to prometheus-scrape-config, canary to eu-west-1 first.
Alix (eng-runtime): Confirm exporter still exposing model_id only? can we also revert exporter to emit both labels? That would be ideal for future-proofing.
Sam (eng-oncall): Revert would require a patch and deploy across regions; relabel is faster. We'll do relabel + plan a non-urgent exporter follow-up to emit both labels.
Priya (support): I'll update customer with ETA ~20m for canary and then global. telling them graphs will come back when relabel flips.
Sam (eng-oncall): canary deployed to eu-west-1 at 2026-03-16T14:05Z. dashboards in eu-west-1 showing QPS returning for some panels.
Maya (observability): Monitoring: us-west-2 still zero, eu-west-1 restored. proceeding full rollout now.
observability-bot: runbook: prometheus relabel change applied to all scrape configs by sam at 2026-03-16T14:12Z
Jonathan (platform): After relabel, we should add a transitional rule in dashboards: use coalesce(label_replace(metric, "model", "$1", "model", "(.*)"), metric... ) — but simpler: dashboard queries now accept both labels with OR clauses.
Alix (eng-runtime): filing follow-up ticket to have exporter emit both model and model_id and add unit test to prevent label-only flips in future. Ticket: INF-4578.
Priya (support): Customer updated: graphs returned after ~12m in eu-west-1, full restore in ~17m. Customer satisfied with timeline. Closing escalation unless regressions.
Sam (eng-oncall): marking incident resolved, will post postmortem with timeline and root cause (exporter label change without coordinating dashboard/metrics compatibility). :white_check_mark:
Priya (support): thanks team! :raised_hands:
